faqs.a:
It is the intent of this chapter to provide for continuity of government (
section 13.7
, Arvada Charter) and for the necessary organization, powers, and authority to enable
               the timely and effective use of all available city resources to prepare for, respond
               to and recover from civil emergencies, emergencies, or local disasters, whether natural
               or manmade, that are likely to affect the health, security, safety, or property of
               the inhabitants of the city. It is intended to grant as broad a power as permitted
               within the letter and spirit of the Arvada City Charter and the city council-city
               manager form of government. The city council retains the power to direct the city
               manager during the pendency of a declaration.
(
Ord. No. 4827
, § 2, 12-5-2022)
Charter reference—
Continuity of government, § 13-7.
